description: This file defines a Spring service listener that tracks changes in loan status within the Fineraft platform. It registers an event listener that responds to 'LoanStatusChangedBusinessEvent' events, recording history entries for specific loan statuses configured via properties.

classes.name: LoanStatusChangeHistoryListener
classes.description: A Spring service that listens for loan status change events and records history entries for particular loan statuses.

classes.name: LoanStatusChangedListener
classes.description: A nested class implementing the business event listener for handling individual loan status change events.

methods.name: addListeners
methods.description: Initializes the listener by determining applicable loan statuses and registering event listeners accordingly.

methods.name: getLoanStatuses
methods.description: Parses a string configuration into a set of LoanStatus enums, supporting special keywords 'NONE' and 'ALL'.

methods.name: onBusinessEvent
methods.description: Handles a loan status change event, logging the change and recording history entries if relevant.
